title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer


Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.


AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.


The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.


This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation.
  • Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services.
  • Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA.
  • Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate.
  • Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service.
  • Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards.
  • Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards.
  • Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.


Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

  • 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above.
  • Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery.
  • Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering.
  • IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning.
  • DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience.
  • Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity.
  • Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments.
  • Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

  • Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS.
  • SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

  • Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch.
  • AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store.
  • AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

  • Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management.
  • Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA.
  • Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup.
  • Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

  • Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office.
  • Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role.
  • Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage.
  • Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage.
  • On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover)

Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions.

The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact
  • Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders.
  • Retention Analysis & Insight
  • Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk.
  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance
  • Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn.
  • Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation
  • Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.



Required Qualifications & Experience

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role.
  • Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting.
  • High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs.
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.
  • Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

description:

About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


About the Role:

We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here!


As a Data Associate, you will:

  • Own high-impact data products end-to-end — driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You’ll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You’ll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights.
  • Tackle complex data problems independently , using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous.

You’ll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams — coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation.
  • Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines , contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and PySpark

  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing

For You:

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Role Overview

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U.S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.


What You Will Do-

  • High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via , regional job boards, GitHub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing.
  • HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact.
  • Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.


The DNA We Are Looking For-

The Baseline (Hard Skills):

  • Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese.
  • Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus.
  • Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U.S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.


Core Traits (Soft Skills):

  • The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions.
  • Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.


What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face

What You Will Get:

  • Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn.
  • The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network.
  • A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.


The Challenges You Will Face:

  • 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule.
  • Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.


If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let’s talk. Apply now and let’s make a global impact together!

title: Senior Auditor – Licensing & Compliance (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Auditor – Licensing & Compliance (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

 About Us  


At Simplify CCS, we specialize in innovative contract compliance audits that deliver real value to our clients. Our work supports companies in safeguarding their strategic relationships with vendors, customers, and partners. Since 2014, we've combined expertise in audits, data analytics, and risk management to provide world-class Strategic Contract Risk Management Solutions. 


Headquartered in USA, with a presence in LATAM and EMEA, Simplify serves a global clientele, growing exponentially for over 10 years because our clients understand and appreciate our approach to compliance testing through data analysis, delivered by our team of well trained and motivated subject matter experts. We are a growing international company, and we’re excited to expand our presence in Latin America—starting with you. 


Our purpose: Detect the Unseen. Defend Fairness. Deliver Trust. 


 Your Role & Responsibilities 


You’ll play a key role in owning and executing audit engagements, ensuring compliance with internal controls and external standards, and contributing directly to client-facing work. This is a senior individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities although with responsibility for mentoring, guiding, and reviewing the work of junior auditors 


We are hiring for one experienced audit professional with approximately 5–6+ years of relevant audit experience who is comfortable working independently in a small, fast-moving environment. 


Your main areas of impact: 


  • Lead Licensing Audit Engagements: Take ownership of reviewing and analyzing licensing agreements, contracts, and large datasets to assess compliance and identify potential financial recovery opportunities. 
  • Advanced Data Analysis & Testing: Design and execute audit test plans, independently analyze client data, identify anomalies, and quantify discrepancies with minimal oversight. 
  • Client-Facing Reporting & Insights: Draft clear, well-structured audit reports that communicate key findings, root causes, and practical recommendations to improve client governance and contract compliance. 
  • Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders and global team members, proactively sharing progress, risks, and insights to ensure audits are delivered on time and to a high standard. 
  • Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to improving audit methodologies, templates, and internal processes. Support internal initiatives such as training, documentation, and continuous improvement efforts. 


✅ What You Bring 


  • You hold a degree in Accounting, or Finance and are eager to apply your knowledge in real-world audit scenarios; professional certifications (CPA, CIA, CISA, ACCA) are a plus 
  • 5–6+ years of experience in Contract Compliance auditing and/or Forensic Accounting within professional services; experience in the licensing industry is plus.
  • Expert in Excel and familiar with data tools such as Power BI and similar. 
  • English Level Advanced (C1/C2 Required). 
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, skilled to identify risks, patterns and inconsistencies within contracts and large datasets. 
  • Proactive Team player, demonstrating flexibility, resilience, and the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and working hours. 
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex audit findings and present insights to stakeholders with confidence and impact. 
  • Ability to mentor and develop junior team members, providing guidance, feedback, and ongoing support. 


 What We Offer (LATAM - Remote) 


  • Fully Remote Setup 
  • Flexible Hours: Adapt your work schedule to fit your rhythm—coordinate global projects without overtime overload (mostly following EST time zone).  
  • Paid learning: Access to language courses, online platforms, professional certifications all tailored to your personal and career goals. 
  • Competitive USD compensation 
  • Team Culture: Join a diverse, supportive team that values open communication, transparency, and collaboration. 
  • Global Exposure: Gain hands-on experience with international clients across LATAM, EMEA, and North America. 
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy 26 days of paid vacation each year to rest, recharge, and come back inspired. 
  • Fully Equipped for Success: We’ll provide all the equipment you need — from laptops to accessories — so you can do your best work from anywhere. 
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Your well-being matters. We offer healthcare coverage to ensure you’re supported both personally and professionally. 


We value collaboration, integrity, accountability, and a strong client-first mindset, while always finding ways to get great work done. 


⏰ Recruitment Process 


  • Application: Submit your application via . 
  • Initial Screening: Our team will review your profile to assess fit and experience. 
  • Phone Interview: A short introductory call to understand your motivation and answer initial questions. 
  • Technical Assessment: You'll complete a practical task or case study. 
  • Final Interview: Meet with senior team members for a deeper conversation about the role and your potential fit. 
  • Offer: If it's a match, you'll receive a formal offer to join our team!

Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Java Pleno – Platform Engineering em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Como Desenvolvedor Java Pleno na vertical de Platform Engineering Sankhya, você atuará no desenvolvimento e evolução contínua de sistema internos e automações utilizando Java e Spring, está junto com o time na missão de evoluir um IDP (Internal Developer Platform) e terá uma evolução contínua das práticas de DevOps, contribuindo para a melhoria de processos, ferramentas e automações.

Sua atuação estará focada na estabilidade, automação e confiabilidade dos ambientes, com forte participação no desenvolvimento e evolução de sistemas internos, trabalhando em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, segurança e operações.

Se você busca atuar em ambientes desafiadores, com oportunidades de aprendizado contínuo e participação ativa na evolução das práticas de engenharia, essa vaga é para você.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir sistemas internos e automações utilizando Java e Spring;
  • Apoiar na análise e resolução de problemas de performance e disponibilidade, incluindo análise de aplicações Java em ambientes distribuídos;
  • Atuar na implementação e melhoria de pipelines de CI/CD, garantindo integração eficiente com aplicações desenvolvidas em Java;
  • Apoiar na análise de processos, ferramentas e práticas DevOps, contribuindo na identificação de melhorias e na execução de planos de evolução definidos;
  • Contribuir na implementação de práticas de infraestrutura como código (ex.: Terraform), além de apoiar iniciativas de monitoramento, logging e observabilidade;
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, segurança e operações na melhoria da confiabilidade e estabilidade dos ambientes;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e boas práticas com o time, contribuindo para a evolução técnica coletiva.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java e Spring (Spring Boot, APIs REST, etc.) ;
  • Experiência em containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Experiência com Linux;
  • Vivência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares);
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação como GitHub Actions.
  • Conhecimento com cloud computing (AWS, GCP ou OCI);



LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT


BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

Remote from Brazil | Independent Contractor | Part‑time / Flexible Hours

Your Impact in 30 Seconds

Somos a @Runtalent, com DNA inovador, consolidados no mercado de tecnologia e especializados em soluções de TI há quase duas décadas. Acompanhamos todos os avanços tecnológicos dos últimos anos e estamos juntos nessa corrida pela transformação digital.

  • Experience APIs;
  • Process APIs;
  • System APIs.

  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e CI/CD aplicadas a integrações.

title: Analista Desenvolvedor Salesforce Pleno (Marketing Cloud)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Desenvolvedor Salesforce Pleno (Marketing Cloud) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A AI/R Everymind , fundada em novembro de 2014, é parceira oficial da Salesforce desde 2015 e especialista multicloud. Desenvolvemos soluções que transformam negócios de todos os portes e setores, unindo visão 360°, expertise tecnológica e uma mentalidade de inovação pioneira.


Somos parte da AI/R , a AI Revolution Company. Uma conexão estratégica de componentes revolucionários que incorporam a Inteligência Artificial por completo.


Você gosta de um desafio ? Junte-se a nós, venha ser um Everyminder!


#LI-JF1


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Desenvolver, configurar e manter campanhas e jornadas no Salesforce Marketing Cloud utilizando Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio e Automation Studio.
  • Implementar automações para processos de marketing, integrações de dados e disparos de campanhas.

  • Desenvolver e ajustar templates de e-mail e landing pages utilizando HTML e CSS.
  • Participar de integrações entre Marketing Cloud e sistemas externos através de APIs REST/SOAP e conectores nativos.
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica das entregas, seguindo boas práticas de desenvolvimento, segurança e governança de dados.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com consultores, analistas, arquitetos e equipes de negócio para implementação de soluções.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Experiência prática com Salesforce Marketing Cloud .
  • Conhecimento em Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio e Contact Builder.
  • Domínio de SQL para criação de segmentações e tratamento de dados.
  • Experiência com AMPscript para personalização de campanhas.
  • Conhecimento em HTML e CSS para construção e manutenção de e-mails responsivos.
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de falhas em jornadas, automações e integrações.
  • Conhecimento de integrações via API REST e SOAP.


Diferenciais:


  • Certificações Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Specialist, Developer ou Consultant).
  • Conhecimento em Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS).
  • Experiência com Data Cloud, Personalization, Account Engagement (Pardot) ou Intelligence (Datorama).
  • Vivência em projetos utilizando metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência com integrações em Salesforce Core (Sales Cloud e Service Cloud).
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Benefícios oferecidos:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Auxílio Home Office
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados
  • Programa de apoio a certificações
  • Plano de Assistência Médica (com coparticipação e mensalidade para dependentes)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Day Off de Aniversário
  • Zenklub
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
  • Programa Talkers – apoio no inglês
  • Parcerias com instituições de ensino com descontos em cursos MBA e pós-graduação


Opcionais com mensalidade:

  • Plano Odontológico
  • Total Pass

title: Data Product Associate
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Product Associate em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


About the Role:

We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here!


As a Data Associate, you will:

  • Own high-impact data products end-to-end — driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You’ll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You’ll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights.
  • Tackle complex data problems independently , using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous.
  • Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage — significantly increasing speed, reducing manual work, and beginning to automate portions of workflows. You’ll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams — coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation.
  • Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines , contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and PySpark
  • You have a proven track record of quickly learning new concepts, particularly complex data methodologies, and building strong mental models of how and why data works
  • You actively use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate your work and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing
  • You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company
  • You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, independently prioritize tasks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information
  • You have experience using sample or panel data to make precise estimates that guide decision-making
  • You have a background in financial markets or are interested in learning more about data-driven investing
  • You have an Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)


For You:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Inside Sales Account Executive, North America
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Inside Sales Account Executive, North America em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: anywhere in LATAM


JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :


  • Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Craft and execute your territory sales plan & progress opportunities in the pipeline.
  • Provide product demos to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians in North America.
  • Proactively communicate with clients and users through emails and calls.
  • Analyze trends and make data driven decisions on priorities in your work.
  • Work effectively with other teams such as marketing to deliver on sales targets, team projects and campaigns.


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
  • Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Experienced with Salesforce and platforms such as Hubspot.
  • Confidence in dealing with clients and product users.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, results-oriented and willing to learn new skills.
  • A drive to succeed and a proven ability to be resilient and overcome challenges.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer


Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.


AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.


The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.


This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation.
  • Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services.
  • Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA.
  • Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate.
  • Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service.
  • Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards.
  • Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards.
  • Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.


Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

  • 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above.
  • Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery.
  • Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering.
  • IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning.
  • DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience.
  • Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity.
  • Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments.
  • Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

  • Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS.
  • SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

  • Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch.
  • AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store.
  • AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

  • Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management.
  • Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA.
  • Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup.
  • Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

  • Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office.
  • Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role.
  • Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage.
  • Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage.
  • On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer


Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.


AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.


The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.


This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation.
  • Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services.
  • Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA.
  • Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate.
  • Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service.
  • Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards.
  • Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards.
  • Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.


Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

  • 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above.
  • Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery.
  • Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering.
  • IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning.
  • DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience.
  • Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity.
  • Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments.
  • Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

  • Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS.
  • SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

  • Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch.
  • AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store.
  • AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

  • Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management.
  • Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA.
  • Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup.
  • Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

  • Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office.
  • Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role.
  • Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage.
  • Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage.
  • On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Java Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma SaaS que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.


Propósito do Cargo

Como Senior Java Developer , você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.


Responsabilidades Principais:

Desenvolvimento Backend

  • Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração.
  • Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe.
  • Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção.
  • Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput.
  • Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas.


Design e Arquitetura

  • Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios.
  • Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos.
  • Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos.
  • Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas.


Banco de Dados e Integrações

  • Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados.
  • Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados.
  • Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais.
  • Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas.


Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações WebLogic.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment.
  • Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos.
  • Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe.
  • Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA.
  • Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas.


Colaboração e Crescimento

  • Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento.
  • Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java.
  • Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes).
  • Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design GoF (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema.
  • Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras.
  • Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte.
  • Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual.
  • Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/OpenAPI para desenvolvimento de APIs.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta.
  • Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning.
  • Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing.
  • Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs.
  • Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações WebLogic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares.
  • Experiência trabalhando em plataformas SaaS ou sistemas multi-tenant.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.


O Que Valorizamos:

  • Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana.
  • Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo.
  • Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness.
  • Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe.
  • Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real.
  • Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício.
  • Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar.


Processo de Candidatura:

  • Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo .
  • Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo.
  • Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência.
  • Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

Na VMetrix , não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Arquiteto Cloud & DevOps Sênior
description:

Viva a experiência SONDA

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!



Por que fazer parte da SONDA?



Porque assim como você, amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.

Nesta função você irá:

  • Implementar e administrar ambientes conteinerizados utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Amazon EKS e ECS;
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código (IaC), promovendo padronização, escalabilidade e automação dos ambientes;
  • Implementar soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e troubleshooting utilizando CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de incidentes críticos, realizando análises de causa raiz e garantindo estabilidade operacional dos ambientes;
  • Implementar e administrar soluções de segurança cloud, incluindo IAM, WAF, Security Groups, políticas de acesso, compliance e governança;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, realizando análise e otimização de custos dos ambientes cloud;
  • Desenvolver integrações e automações através de APIs e serviços de infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar projetos de dados e analytics utilizando serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e operações, apoiando decisões técnicas e arquiteturais;
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, workflows Git, gestão de repositórios e versionamento semântico;
  • Participar da definição de padrões arquiteturais, melhoria contínua e evolução tecnológica dos ambientes corporativos;
  • Criar e manter documentações técnicas, diagramas e padrões operacionais;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e hands-on em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade tecnológica.



Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior cursando ou completo;
  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura, administração e sustentação de ambientes Cloud Multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP);
  • Vivência em projetos de infraestrutura cloud escalável, resiliente e segura;
  • Conhecimento avançado em DevOps, GitOps e automação de infraestrutura;
  • Experiência prática com CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions e pipelines automatizados;
  • Forte experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform e CloudFormation;
  • Conhecimento em containers e orquestração com Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Amazon EKS e ECS;
  • Experiência em automação e integração via APIs para infraestrutura e operações;
  • Conhecimento em Linux, redes, SDN, armazenamento (SDS) e virtualização de containers;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de incidentes em ambientes complexos;
  • Conhecimento em segurança cloud, IAM, WAF, Security Groups e boas práticas de governança;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados e serviços de dados em cloud;
  • Experiência com serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Conhecimento em versionamento Git, workflows de repositórios, tags e versionamento semântico;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de automação e scripting como Python, Shell Script e JavaScript;
  • Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para atuação colaborativa entre times multidisciplinares;
  • Perfil hands-on, proativo e orientado à melhoria contínua;
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes ágeis e dinâmicos.



Será considerando um diferencial:

  • Certificações AWS, como:
  • AWS Solutions Architect
  • AWS DevOps Engineer
  • AWS Security Specialist
  • Conhecimento em FinOps e otimização de custos cloud;
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a microsserviços;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de alta criticidade.



O que você pode esperar de nós?


  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?


  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!



+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração



Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.



Faça parte da nossa equipe!

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As the Team Lead for Portuguese Sketches, you oversee the end-to-end production workflow, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and timely delivery of localized content. You lead a cross-functional team and ensure alignment between English and Portuguese Sketches while maintaining strict audio, visual, and subtitle quality standards.


In addition to overseeing production workflow, this role functions as a key operational stabilizer within the Portuguese content ecosystem. The Team lead ensures asset readiness, prevents production bottlenecks, bridges cross-time-zone collaboration, and safeguards content integrity across localized adaptations, enabling consistent and reliable execution at scale.


Key Responsibilities


Leadership & Workflow Management


  • Team Leadership & Workflow Management: Assign daily tasks, prioritize deliverables, and ensure smooth coordination across Video Editors and QC Specialists.


  • Production Continuity Ownership: Ensure editors are never blocked due to missing assets, incomplete folders, or lack of resource preparation. Proactively prepare videos, audios, scripts, and subtitles before daily production begins.


  • Cross-Team Asset Coordination: Act as liaison between Spanish/Portugeuse production, US content teams, and India stakeholders to request, follow up, and secure required assets in a timely manner.


  • Process Standardization: Develop and maintain internal documentation (SOPs, transition guides, tracking frameworks) to support workflow clarity, team alignment, and smooth leadership transitions.



Reporting, Assets & Documentation


  • Reporting & Performance Tracking: Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.


  • Asset & Process Management: Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.


  • Repository & Documentation Management : Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.


Quality & Content Oversight


  • Quality Oversight: Ensure full synchronization between visuals, audio, and subtitles; consistent visual style; complete audio mix (vocals, music, SFX); and no unintended logos or asset errors.
  • English–Portuguese Alignment: Maintain narrative and visual coherence between source and localized content.
  • Content Integrity Assurance: Monitor alignment between English source content and Portuguese localized assets across motion episodes, still episodes, promo videos, and thumbnails to ensure narrative coherence and platform consistency.


Operations & Issue Resolution


  • Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.


  • Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.


Reporting, Assets & Documentation


  • Reporting & Performance Tracking: Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.


  • Asset & Process Management: Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.


  • Repository & Documentation Management: Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.


Operations & Issue Resolution


  • Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.
  • Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.
  • Risk Prevention & Escalation: Identify operational risks (delays, inconsistencies, technical issues) early and escalate proactively to prevent impact on timelines and overall production output.



Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Production, Linguistics, Media, or a related field.
  • Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with advanced knowledge of Portuguese grammar and orthography.
  • Proven experience in quality control, audio/video production, or a related content operations role.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Suite (including Premiere); familiarity with CMS platforms required. Experience reviewing AI-generated content is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail with a critical eye for audiovisual quality and consistency.
  • Demonstrated leadership and team management experience.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as operational backbone in high-volume content environments, ensuring production continuity and workflow stability.
  • Proven experience anticipating production risks (asset gaps, sync inconsistencies, narrative misalignment) and implementing preventive solutions before escalation.
  • Strong cross-cultural communication skills, with experience bridging expectations between international stakeholders (e.g., US and India teams) and local production teams.
  • Experience building structured documentation, repositories, and tracking systems that enhance team clarity and reduce operational friction.
  • Ability to maintain narrative and technical coherence despite creative divergence across markets.
  • High level of ownership and accountability over end-to-end production outcomes.
  • Strategic operational mindset with the ability to balance creative integrity, technical precision, and workflow efficiency.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

We are looking for a FULL-TIME Customer Success Manager to be the main point of contact between our customers and our technical team.

CLEAR, CONFIDENT ENGLISH IS OUR #1 REQUIREMENT.


You will be speaking directly with our US-based customers on live calls, demos, and video meetings, so you need to communicate comfortably and be easily understood in real time.

  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Strong organization and follow-through.
  • Comfortable talking with customers and presenting.
  • Professional, calm, and genuinely good with people.
  • A self-starter who makes sure things get done.



Our Company is Deep Fork Automation, and you will join a team of 10 (most of whom are international remote workers). 

We work in Automation, SCADA and Remote Monitoring.



You will be paid in US Dollars. On top of monthly salary, we include National holidays off, Paid Time Off, and other benefits. 

Additionally, we have annual performance reviews with raises and bonuses.

We hope this works out and can become a very long term employment opportunity.

Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)


Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (Long-Term)


About the Opportunity

We are seeking a kind, curious, and highly collaborative Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and building exceptional user experiences.

This team is responsible for creating seamless and compelling digital experiences that make it easy for customers to engage with a premium e-commerce and consignment platform. The engineering culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, individual growth, and professional development.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be both a hands-on technical contributor and a key influencer in shaping engineering direction. You will lead and contribute to significant initiatives, mentor fellow engineers through code reviews and pair programming, and help drive the evolution of a modern technology platform.

This opportunity is ideal for engineers passionate about luxury retail, e-commerce, sustainability, and circular economy business models.


What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable, performant, and testable software solutions.
  • Build and enhance customer-facing applications that directly support strategic business initiatives.
  • Contribute to technical architecture and engineering decisions that shape the future of the platform.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver impactful features.
  • Review pull requests and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to teammates.
  • Participate in pair programming and knowledge-sharing activities across the team.
  • Deploy production-ready code and support applications throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Continuously learn and explore new technologies, design patterns, and engineering practices.


Technology Stack

You will have the opportunity to work with a modern technology stack including:

  • Java
  • Kotlin
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript
  • GraphQL
  • Kafka
  • AWS Lambda
  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB

Legacy services currently include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Elixir
  • React


Required Experience & Skills

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Java or Kotlin, along with experience working in Ruby on Rails environments.
  • Expertise in modern JavaScript (ECMAScript), HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience building applications with React and related ecosystem tools, including Node.js and npm.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, IDEs, version control systems, and deployment tools.
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures, GraphQL, and database design fundamentals.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a user-centric engineering mindset.
  • Interest in retail, e-commerce, luxury consignment, sustainability, or circular economy business models.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing or maintaining Kafka-based event streaming solutions.
  • Experience working with Elixir.
  • Experience decomposing monolithic applications into microservices.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.


What Makes You Successful

  • You are curious, adaptable, and continuously seek opportunities to learn.
  • You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy mentoring fellow engineers.
  • You balance technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making.
  • You care deeply about delivering value to users through technology.
  • You are excited by the opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven organization focused on sustainability and premium resale experiences.
